'''2000 Iowa State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Mayhem Collectibles, Iowa on 18 March 2000. [[Nate Ponce]] won it. It is known from Seth Van Winkle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d402">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-iowa-state-championships-3-18d402/ iowa-state-championships-3-18], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 27 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-iowa-state-championships-3-18d402/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Mayhem Collectibles, Iowa
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 35
* '''Winner:''' [[Nate Ponce]]
